$doc: WHERE A GOOD IS WANTED - the demand half of the price, authored by hand.
note: The owner, 2026-09-01: 'trade goods that are needed in that region/ country will be sold higher. For example tobacco from america (cigarette etc) will be very popular in India since they like to smoke.' Price until now was supply-side only: affinity is distance to the nearest producer, so every port wanted every good equally. Each row is an APPETITE - a region, a category, and what that region pays as a multiple. Absent means 1.00. Hand-written and defended one line at a time, the way 0062's entrepots are, because a seeded number can invent a taste but it cannot mean one. AND THE GAME NEVER SAYS WHERE: nothing in this file reaches a screen. A player learns that India pays for tobacco by carrying tobacco to India.
